title: BeeSMP
description: BeeSMP is a brand-new survival server built around long-term gameplay, player stories, and a tight-knit community.
body:
# 🐝 BeeSMP
- Minecraft Version: 1.21.11 (Java)
- Age Requirement: **18+ only** (rare exceptions)
- Whitelist: **Yes**
- Server Type: Semi-vanilla / Community SMP

# 📃 Whitelist & Access
- Players can join the SMP by applying via discord.
- Whitelist applications are handled via all staff.
- ✨ Content creators are welcome and encouraged.

# 🌐 IP / Map Information
beesmp.xyz
Web Map: [Click here](http://beesmp.xyz:25874/)

# 🌍 World Info
- World Generation: 1.21.11
- World Size: 7000 x 7000
- Expands by 2000 x 2000 as needed




# ⛺Custom Textures
- Adds the logo in tab and maybe more fun cosmetics in the future
🗺️ Web Map
- Allows players to view the world in their browser
⚒️ CoreProtect & Inventory Restore
- Allows us to fix any grief or malicious behavior
📱 Discord Syncing
- Allows you to link Discord and Minecraft any type in ⁠『🤖』server-chat
🐎Dual Horse
- Allows two players to ride one horse together
🪑GSit
- Lets you /sit, /spin, /crawl, /lay, and /bellyflop
- You can also right click to sit on slabs, stairs, and carpets
🥾 Quick Paths
 - Move faster on dirt paths, packed mud, mud bricks, and mud brick slabs
🎙️Simple Voice Chat
- Adds proximity voice chat
🌲 Vanilla Refresh
- Adds animations to Leveling Up, Water Splashing, Teleporting to the End
- Items dropped on death do not despawn! Death stats are broadcast on death
- Player Heads drop on death
- Special blocks have improved animations
- Harvesting crops give xp
- Recovery compass shows death coords
- Clocks show you the in-game time
- Dropping an Echo shard on a mob silences it. Place water on it to unsilence
- Dropping a firework on a cake makes a Party Cake
- Mob health is shown above the action bar. Use a spyglass for more info
- Wither drops its head on death
- Items sparkle in the dark or in grass
- Adds a day-counter for every day someone is online
